handoff.objective: Implement the frozen specification EXP-ECDLP-c373eb exactly as written and run it once. Produce the manifest, raw results, the implementation script, and an execution report. Do NOT interpret whether the results support or falsify H-ECDLP-a40416 -- that is a separate, later Coordinator step. Do NOT change any hypothesis or experiment status.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether ECDLP-IDEA-436's D1 profile, on an actual toy-scale curve, behaves exactly as Proposition E predicts (image {0, r} on the canonical lift), whether a null (non-order-n) lift shows genuine intermediate valuations (the discriminating control), and whether a non-rigid three-point functional loses the two-valued collapse a rigid one (Vandermonde) keeps (the RTF-1 probe).
inputs: docs/claims-and-verification.md (certificate discipline: this run's certificate.kind is none, a pure measurement, not a solve claim)

constraints: Implement EXACTLY the frozen specification EXP-ECDLP-c373eb.yaml. Do not deviate from its inputs, controls, metrics, or budget without stopping and reporting why, rather than silently substituting.

Choose one small ordinary E/F_p with p approximately 1009 with good reduction, a minimal Weierstrass model (v_p(discriminant) = 0), and S of prime order n coprime to p. Record the exact curve coefficients, p, n, its factorization (confirm n is prime or record its factorization), and S's coordinates verbatim in the manifest.

Compute the canonical order-n prime-to-p torsion lift S-hat at p-adic precision r=8 via Hensel/Newton lifting on the defining Weierstrass equation plus the order-n condition, starting from S's own F_p coordinates. Use exact integer arithmetic mod p^8 (or a p-adic library such as sympy's p-adics if available) -- floating point is NOT acceptable for this computation.

Part 1: tabulate v_p(x([k]S-hat) - x([j]S-hat)) truncated at r=8 for ALL 1 <= j < k < n. Record the full set of distinct observed values (the 'image'), not just whether it matches {0,8} -- an incomplete tabulation that only checks a few pairs does not discharge this control.

Part 2: construct an arbitrary Hensel lift of S that does NOT satisfy the order-n condition (i.e., lift S's coordinates via Hensel's lemma applied to the curve equation alone, without also enforcing [n](x,y) = O -- so the result is A p-adic point reducing to S mod p, but not necessarily of order exactly n in E(Q_p)). Repeat the identical Part 1 tabulation using this null lift instead of S-hat. Record its full image set.

Part 3: on the canonical lift S-hat, tabulate v_p of (a) the Vandermonde functional (product of the three pairwise x-coordinate differences of [k1]S-hat, [k2]S-hat, [k3]S-hat, for a representative sample of triples, or all triples if n is small enough to be exhaustive within budget) and (b) one non-rigid three-point functional, for example v_p(x([k1]S-hat)*x([k2]S-hat) - x([k3]S-hat)), over the SAME triples. Record both image sets.

The run's certificate block must have kind: none (this is a pure measurement; no discrete-log solve or decomposition is claimed). State explicitly in the execution report and the manifest that this computation can only observe 'at least r', never infinity, per the control's own disclosed limitation -- do not word the report as if a truncated valuation of r were literally infinity.

Independently spot-check your own p-adic arithmetic implementation: hand-verify (or verify via an independent, simpler recomputation path in the same script) at least one (j,k) pair's tabulated value before trusting the full tabulation, and record this spot-check explicitly in the execution report.

Budget: wall_clock_seconds_per_run 600, maximum_memory_gb 1, maximum_runs 1, total_cpu_hours 0.02 -- this computation should complete in well under one CPU-minute per the control's own design; if it does not, stop and report why rather than silently exceeding scope.

Do NOT interpret the results (whether they support or falsify H-ECDLP-a40416), do NOT change any hypothesis or experiment status, and do NOT create any B71, DEC, KN-FIND, KN-OPEN, or CORR record. That is reserved for a subsequent Coordinator step.
Do NOT claim any discrete-log solve, attack, speedup, novelty, closure, or breakthrough. This is a bounded toy-scale measurement per docs/claims-and-verification.md's toy tier.
